about: The fabric-agent-contract's folder-attribution vectors (DEC-0089, rule FAC-SEM-121). folder_attribution.py ports src/folder-attribution.ts of the same commit, and tests/test_folder_attribution.py runs every vector against it. The copy is JSON-identical to the contract's file: the only change is that the colon of each of the contract's planted fake userinfo is written as a JSON escape, so the public-release gate's credential-URL pattern does not read a test value as a credential. canonicalSha256 is the SHA-256 of the parsed document re-serialised with sorted keys and no spaces; the test checks it. Never edit the vectors here: take a new copy from the contract and update this pin.
status: pinned to the merge commit of the contract's pull request #124 (DEC-0089); src/ and the vectors are unchanged from the reviewed head a11d6193
